description.text: Moving Oklahoma Industries forward. The Center of Workforce Excellence at Rose State serves as a go-to resource, offering educational programs for business, government, and thousands of students each year.

targetApplicants.text: Eligibility : Open to start-ups, existing businesses, and those in the ideation phase. Companies must submit a business plan, pitch deck, and supporting documents to be considered.
